description: Sun and shadows for the site (needs a site location: set_site): it changes the project's saved sun (not an undo step). Date YYYY-MM-DD and time in hours local to the site (e.g. 9.5 = 09:30). Returns the sun's azimuth (degrees clockwise from north) and altitude. Use with capture_view for shadow studies.
name: set_sun
title: Set the sun
